traffic_forecast_summary: Customer provided telemetry from Hosted trial: avg daily QPS ~1.8 during business hours, peak observed ~60 QPS during synthetic stress tests. Realistic early-production projection: 40 QPS sustained with 250 concurrent active users. Token mix: 70% short chat turns (avg 30 tokens response), 20% embeddings for search (avg 512 tokens), 10% long summarization jobs (avg 1,200 tokens). Forecast for month-1 GA: 4.5M tokens/day, migrating to 12M tokens/day at month-6 under growth scenario. Key constraint: p50 latency target <=200ms for chat, p95 <800ms. Cost sensitivity: want cost per 1M tokens < $X (modeled in pricing deck).
dedicated_sizing_notes: Baseline compute need: plan for 2x reserved inference pods to handle steady 40 QPS with headroom for KV cache effectiveness
Burst capacity: require 3x burstable nodes for marketing spikes (expected 2-3x baseline for <1 hour/day)
Model selection: mix of 1x base-llm-16k for chat (quantized), 1x embed-compact for embeddings; fallback to smaller 8k model when latency budgets tighten
Batching strategy: prefer small continuous batching for chat (batch size 8-16) and larger batched runs for embeddings to reduce cost
KV/prefix caching: expected to reduce token compute by ~22% on support-agent routes based on trial patterns
SLOs & routing: primary region NA-east; plan failover to NA-west with lower-tier model for non-critical summarization during outages
Monitoring: require token-level cost breakdown, route-level p50/p95, and trace links to source request ids (already demoed in Console)
